notes.title: Remnants of R'lyeh Final Demo Now Live!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/aabf74eb0ac11d4da3685522ca2fa55ae8284416.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794010/Remnants_of_Rlyeh_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We strongly recommend playing with keyboard and mouse for the best experience.[/p][p][/p][p]This final demo includes two playable chapters, with a third coming soon:[/p][p][/p][p]Chapters:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Falling [/p][/*][*][p]Deepsea Nightmare[/p][/*][/olist][p]Whether you're new or played the 2022 demo, these two chapters offer a completely fresh experience—immersing you in a Lovecraftian atmosphere and the terror of the deep sea.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]      [/p][p]      3.innsmouth (WIP)[/p][p][/p][p]The island level from the 2022 version is currently being remade and optimized. In its place, a brand-new Innsmouth chapter is in development. Due to technical reasons, it is still undergoing adjustments and will be released soon (with a separate update announcement). This chapter is designed to showcase the game's core survival horror shooting experience—stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this demo! Your feedback means a lot to us. notes.title: Game Dev Log and More About The Story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/51193427104d6a8df7d92fe149afbe307f332720.png[/img]



Hello everyone! Welcome back to the development log for "Remnants of R'lyeh." I will show you the game's new progress, new mechanics, and some interesting development stories. Thank you for the continuous attention and support from new and returning players!


Since the last demo update, I kept working hard on the full game. It is painful sometimes when you are alone and game development is very challenging but I know that is what I love and what I am passionate about. I was struggling with mental health issue due to my work which I did not like and right now I am happy cuz I quit the job and fully focus on game development. 

In the full game, there will be lots of new contents, I optimized the underwater experience for you and more weapons, enemies, puzzles and areas to explore. Here are some new screenshots：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/c713025470ea59e049d00cfb11d9dfd205875555.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/d813230ca4ce8117557b8e6e533781007672d6a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/1a699512626afbab5bd6844db6b88fea0d3bf4eb.jpg[/img]

Yes, you need to explore and discover the dark secrets of a giant steel underwater city! Using the deep-sea tech weapons, try to survive and escape the nightmare, face the abyss monsters in the dark...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/bb2f9c5742a61f37c5d46771ed04b5bf6281bacb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/66ee2d4457fb48e8a37b2ca06181f49531902c33.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/87e72a2b16baece8c270be7237735fece46c9fa6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41379573/a86267785e45fc2c376d135be818bb809a39618f.jpg[/img]

Please stayed tuned, I will keep updating the game development process on Twitter / Youtube / Steam

Thank you so much for your support!

[previewyoutube=mQi1ggKhMJc;full][/previewyoutube]
